correctness.rationale: For any graph G, edge-symbol independence gives centralizer equations a_i b_j-a_j b_i=0 per edge. If S={i:a_i !=0}, neighbors outside S have b_j=0; on each connected component of G[S], solutions are a scalar multiple of x restricted to that component; vertices U=V\N[S] are independent. All these component vectors centralize one another and all U, and brackets on U are exactly those of L_{G[U]}. Thus C(x) ~= L_{G[U]} directsum k^(m+c(S)-|E(G[U])|), including isolated vertices and char2. Counting q^m(q-1)^|S| over supports gives the full isomorphism-type distribution and H_G(q;t,w). Independent 64-support enumeration confirmed six-vertex pair A derived rank5 count zero and B exactly one singleton-support contribution q^7(q-1); known equal adjoint-rank polynomials separately match inspected verifier. Derived dimension is |E(G[U])|, not a substitute for whole Lie algebra type.
